verdict.comment: Hat-trick seekers Diplomatic Ash and Good Friday Fairy have to be shortlisted but slight preference is for CALL OFF THE DOGS.

comments.calloffthedogs: Good record here; off since November but he's still one to note with ground to suit
comments.diplomaticash: His career seems to be taking off again (two wins here this month) and he's respected
comments.docmccoy: This season's four runs over fences were not inspiring; cheekpieces latest, now blinkers
comments.fameandfun: Won easily here (2m6f, heavy) in January and he did win on good ground one year ago
comments.goodfridayfairy: Bidding for 3-3 in cheekpieces; the move away from soft/heavy may be the chief question
comments.hatos: Made the frame on all five starts this season but soundly beaten last two; tongue-tie off
comments.joecotton: It's easy to see him on the premises if first-time blinkers don't have an adverse effect
comments.koenigsstern: 2m2f win here in December; not so good next time and tailed off in cheekpieces latest
comments.nextleft: Did well last spring/autumn; beaten 20l on his last two starts; wears headgear first time
comments.royalmer: 2nd last two runs, latest to Diplomatic Ash here; plenty to prove away from soft or heavy
comments.valiranngold: Form is up and down; one win (here last February) in last 20 starts; 4lb out of handicap
comments.zestfulhope: No win away from Hereford but the 5lb rise since winning last time does not rule him out

races.raceComment: goodfridayfairy is marginally preferred with a score of 61.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over royalmer. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Excellent course form of 5/14 at fontwell. Key attributes include positive comments and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

comments.bowstreet: 6f win in November; satisfactory return at Southwell last month; needs more back at 5f
comments.commendation: Made a winning stable debut over C&D last month; no progress in two runs since
comments.earlyrelease: 6f win on stable debut in Dec; two good runs followed but below par last week; wide draw
comments.horus: 6f win here in December was followed by two solid efforts; progress halted the last twice
comments.kodibeat: Poor form for L Mullaney last autumn but tumbled down weights; new yard try a visor
comments.natsumi: 5f win at Chelmsford in November before a C&D second to Solar Edge; below par last time
comments.overspiced: Bright start for this yard but her form has cooled more recently; others are stronger
comments.solaredge: Two 5f nursery wins last year, including here; could yet rate higher as a 3yo
comments.toolatetonegotiate: Running creditably in minor AW handicaps this winter; minor money perhaps her best hope

races.raceComment: solaredge is marginally preferred with a score of 46.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form and more progressive over earlyrelease. verdict.comment: Progressive sorts are thin on the ground but COMBUSTION and Piperstown are notable exceptions.

comments.agentmayfair: Comes here in good form but not sure to reverse latest placings with Combustion
comments.barnsnapeboy: 0-11 and although he has hinted at ability, others look safer for win purposes
comments.coloradadancer: Placed over 7f last month but well held either side of it; new trip today
comments.combustion: 3-3 since dropped to 6f; this demands further progress but it could be forthcoming
comments.dontfightit: Conditions no problem and she holds each-way claims if taking her chance
comments.lilkian: Near miss over C&D in January but he hasn't kicked on since
comments.lynwoodlad: Latest 7f run excusable; earlier Wolverhampton win brings him into the reckoning
comments.mehmo: Solid efforts the last twice but he needs more to overcome a wide draw
comments.missmoonshine: Conditions to suit & placed all 4 times Hollie Doyle has ridden her; now gets cheekpieces
comments.piperstown: Four wins since December, including both times he's been ridden by Rossa Ryan; contender
comments.silkyrobin: 15-race maiden but he'd been threatening prior to a poor run latest; drawn widest

races.raceComment: piperstown is marginally preferred with a score of 54.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over combustion. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 4/13 at lingfield. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A competitive race in which the progressive 4yo REY DE LA BATALLA gets the vote ahead of Tadreeb and Brasil Power.

comments.bataldubai: C&D win in December but he was laboured at Kempton last time and needs to bounce back
comments.brasilpower: Four AW wins over 7f and he could be dangerous dropped back in trip and grade
comments.diamondonthehill: 7yo who is 0-7 on AW but he's been running well this year; respected
comments.intervention: On dangerous mark and ran well from tough draw at Wolverhampton last time; each-way claims
comments.lerwick: Runner-up on Tapeta in two of his last three runs; could make a bold bid for new yard
comments.myawele: Both wins at sprint trips and she still has stamina to prove over 7f; down the list
comments.reydelabatalla: Won over C&D last month and he went close over 1m here last time; key player
comments.tadreeb: Three C&D wins for new yard and was runner-up at Kempton (1m) latest; shortlisted

form.raceInstanceTitle: Boost Your Acca At BetMGM Apprentice Handicap
form.rpCloseUpComment: raced in last, still plenty to do when switched right over 1f out, ran on but never near to challenge (inquiry held into running and riding of gelding which raced in rear throughout before staying on strongly down  home straight from an unpromising position to finish 4th of 7 runners, beaten 2 1/4 lengths; jockey stated his instructions were to jump out, sit in box seat and see how race developed from there; he explained that gelding had missed the kick and he therefore accepted his early position and decided to sit last; he indicated that he thought the pace was decent for first 2f before it steadied up leaving back straight on first circuit leaving him further out of his ground than had been intended; from this point in race and during middle stages jockey acknowledged that he was aware pace was slow but he was reluctant to make a forward move to improve his position for fear of getting trapped wide; in explaining his riding from leaving back straight on final circuit, he stated that he was again hesitant to switch wide, due to concerns he could end up at least 4 wide around outside of runners, so committed to ride for luck down inner in hope of obtaining a clear passage between rivals on rail or to the inside of a rival if runners fanned approaching home bend, which they often do at Wolverhampton, but it failed to materialise on this occasion and he was denied clear running for some distance approaching  2f marker; on straightening for home he managed to switch gelding to outside, mounting his challenge and gelding had stayed on very well through to line; trainer confirmed instructions; however expressed disappointment that even allowing for fact that gelding wasn't quickest into stride, greater effort had not been made by rider to ensure gelding settled more prominently and was ridden to instructions; trainer also indicated that he was dissatisfied with fact that jockey failed to switch wider and improve his position on to the back of favourite for some distance from approaching 3f marker until entering home straight; jockey told stewards he was still very inexperienced riding in staying races and only had approximately 50 career rides to his name)

verdict.comment: In-form mare VIXEY gets the verdict ahead of Down To The Kid, whose turn may be near.

comments.downtothekid: Couple of second-place finishes over C&D since dropped back to 1m; in the mix
comments.foreverproud: On last winning mark; good chance provided she takes well to new headgear
comments.jackdaniel: Finished last of ten over C&D in sole outing for new stable
comments.jezbomb: Progressive in September/October; beaten twice since but isn't written off
comments.lightupourstars: Recent strike-rate is modest; only one win in the last 17 months
comments.tasmanianlegend: Stone below last winning mark but has become inconsistent; not solid
comments.timetobenice: 0-11 in handicaps but has possibilities off a reduced mark dropped to Class 6
comments.vixey: Likely player provided her recent 7f form is transferred to this longer trip

races.raceComment: jezbomb is confidently preferred with a score of 56.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over lightupourstars. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
